window: 2026-11-18..11-25；鼻整形 2 条（11-23 唇裂鼻单柱支撑+碎肋软骨 16 例、11-20 多模态 AI 咨询双盲评分 20 例）；第 3 条按轮换取拉皮（11-23 术中颧面神经定位 158 例）；PRP 本期仅有骨科、喉科、勃起功能及摘要缺失的毛发条目，不取；颅骨修复 3 条（系统综述、战伤野战个案、PEEK 预印本）本轮不取；小阴唇 0 条。

items.title: Septum-Anchored Teostrut With Diced Costal Cartilage for Definitive Asian Cleft Rhinoplasty
items.fact_zh: 回顾性 16 例亚洲唇腭裂修复后患者，做定型期鼻整形：鼻尖用锚定在鼻中隔的单柱移植物（Teostrut）支撑，鼻背用切碎肋软骨铺垫。术后照片测量鼻背偏斜改善 0.9°，鼻翼角不对称改善约 11–13°，69% 患者自报鼻通气好转，无重大并发症。
items.take_zh: 创新点：把鼻中隔锚定的单柱移植物和切碎肋软骨合用于亚洲唇裂鼻，16 例且有客观照片测量。意义：唇裂鼻二次修复可拿碎软骨垫鼻背、避开整块移植的僵硬；但无对照组、随访期没报，只算初步可行。
items.scene_zh: 患者问唇裂的鼻子做过一次还能不能再修，我说能，鼻尖拿一根固定在鼻中隔的支撑顶着，鼻背用碎肋软骨一点点垫，但得先看你鼻中隔够不够使。
items.fact_en: This retrospective series reports 16 Asian patients with repaired cleft lip and palate who underwent definitive rhinoplasty using a septum-anchored monopod graft (Teostrut) for tip support plus diced costal cartilage for dorsal augmentation. Photographic analysis showed 0.9 degrees of improvement in dorsum deviation and roughly 11 to 13 degrees of correction in alar angle asymmetry; 69% of patients reported functional improvement and there were no major complications.
items.take_en: The innovation is pairing a septum-anchored monopod strut with diced costal cartilage in the Asian cleft nose, with objective photographic measurement in 16 cases. It offers a reproducible way to support the tip and camouflage the dorsum in secondary cleft deformity, but the series has no control group and does not report follow-up length, so it remains preliminary.
items.first_affil: Cleft and Craniofacial Center, Cipto Mangunkusumo General Hospital, Jakarta

items.title: Intraoperative Mapping of the Zygomaticofacial Nerve: Implications for Safe Dissection in Endoscopic Facelift Surgery
items.fact_zh: 前瞻性研究在 158 例内窥镜拉皮术中，用 30° 内镜双侧辨认颧面神经（zygomaticofacial nerve，ZFN）出孔与分支。单支右侧 82%、左侧 87%，双孔 13% 与 8%，三孔≤2%，双侧缺如 4%；颧面孔距眶下缘约 5.5 mm、距颧弓约 10 mm，左右对称。
items.take_zh: 创新点：颧面神经数据此前多来自尸体，这是 158 例活体术中实测，同类里样本最大。意义：颧区剥离时按距眶下缘 5.5 mm、距颧弓 10 mm 找神经出孔位置，可少伤分支、减少术后颊部麻木；但只测出孔，未随访感觉功能。
items.scene_zh: 患者问拉皮做完脸会不会麻，我说颧骨那块有根细神经，我按量出来的位置绕开它，麻的机会小，但少数人术后还是会木一阵。
items.fact_en: In a prospective intraoperative study of 158 patients undergoing endoscopic facelift, the zygomaticofacial nerve (ZFN) and its foramina were mapped bilaterally under 30-degree endoscopic magnification. A single branch was present in 82% of right and 87% of left sides, double foramina in 13% and 8%, triple foramina in 2% or fewer, and bilateral absence in 4%; mean nerve count was slightly higher on the right (1.13 plus or minus 0.48 versus 1.04 plus or minus 0.38). The foramen averaged about 5.5 mm from the infraorbital rim and 10 mm from the zygomatic arch, with strong bilateral symmetry.
items.take_en: The innovation is living-tissue measurement in 158 patients, the largest series of its kind, where earlier ZFN data came almost entirely from cadavers. Those two distances give a practical landmark for dissection in the zygomatic region, although the study mapped foramina only and did not follow postoperative sensation.
